name: DCA Pym Test Kitchen "Pym-ini" Toasted Salami, Rosemary Ham & Provolone Panini
whyItWorks: Rosemary ham, cured salami, and melted provolone on toasted olive oil focaccia bread with mild marinara dip. Warm, savory, and low in lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pym-ini Panini with a side of marinara sauce or potato bites.
watchOuts: Cured salami has sodium and spices; eat moderate portion
